1:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production asset for Emberfell, a top-down pixel RPG.
The reference image has one resident per ROW: a painted dialogue portrait at left, followed by four poor old pixel animation frames. Redraw these residents as substantially better, clean, professionally hand-pixelled seated upper-body sprites. Preserve EACH resident's exact identity, skin tone, hair silhouette and color, clothing colors and accessories from the OLD SPRITE. Portraits are supporting identity references; do not copy their realistic painting style or change costumes to the portraits. Keep women women and men men, preserve age and species. South-facing symmetric game view, small chibi RPG proportions, complete head and upper torso down to a straight waist edge, arms calmly at sides or hands at lap. No furniture, chairs, table, ground, shadows, legs, or backdrop.
OUTPUT LAYOUT: EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 8 equal rows. Each row one resident in the listed order. Four poses left to right: 1 neutral eyes open, 2 tiny inhale only upper chest/shoulder moves ONE logical pixel with same face, 3 eyelids halfway lowered, 4 eyes COMPLETELY CLOSED as short dark horizontal eyelid lines with NO white or iris. All four poses share exact size, pixel grid, center, hair silhouette, face shape, eyebrows, clothes, palette and bottom baseline. Eyes in both open poses have the EXACT same small defined shape and position, no enlargement or sparkle changes. On blink poses only eyelid pixels change; do not squash head or change nose/mouth/hair. Pixel-art grid with ~40-48 logical pixels per character, enlarged with exact hard square nearest-neighbor pixels. Crisp tidy clusters, limited cohesive colors, no blur, no antialiasing, no gradients, no noise. Small readable eyes rather than giant anime eyes. Subtle warm outline, thoughtful cloth and hair shading. Generous empty transparent margins separate every cell; no overlap. NO labels, text, dividers, numbers, swatches. Genuine transparent background. Canvas portrait format suitable for rows of equal-size sprites. Keep all characters fully inside their cells.
Residents in row order: Ada (dark-skinned woman, black full curls, olive green dress with gold neckline); Bren (dark-skinned man, short black hair and beard, maroon vest and cream sleeves); Berta (fair woman, black updo, rust blouse and charcoal apron); Fara (dark-skinned older woman, long silver-black braids, green/gold dress); Hester (brown-skinned curly dark-haired woman, cream/navy sailor cap and blue clothes); Junia (fair older woman, gray hair cream bonnet, rust dress cream collar); Kellan (dark-skinned bald man, maroon vest cream shirt); Lysa (fair woman auburn bob, olive dress cream neck)..
